evaluator.fail_closed: evaluator errors / missing outputs / malformed metrics are HARD failures, never a 373 penalty

select_M_if: L fails meaningful benefit on fold 0

noninferiority_rationale.regional_dsc_abs: 0.005 Dice ~ sub-noise floor at 1,351 cases; larger L drops are real regressions. Inequality: L_DSC >= M_DSC - 0.005.
noninferiority_rationale.regional_hd95_mm: 0.75 mm < one isotropic voxel (1 mm); tighter would flag resampling jitter. Inequality: L_HD95 <= M_HD95 + 0.75.
noninferiority_rationale.smallest_volume_stratum_dsc_abs: 0.01 on the smallest-lesion stratum where Dice is noisiest. Inequality: L >= M - 0.01.
noninferiority_rationale.dsc_5th_percentile_abs: 0.01 guards the hard-case tail (5th pct). Inequality: L_p05 >= M_p05 - 0.01.
noninferiority_rationale.hd95_95th_percentile_mm: 1.5 mm guards the worst-boundary tail (95th pct). Inequality: L_p95 <= M_p95 + 1.5.
noninferiority_rationale.empty_reference_false_positive_rate_abs: 0.02 caps extra false positives on empty-reference regions. Inequality: L_fp <= M_fp + 0.02.
noninferiority_rationale.missed_region_rate_abs: 0.02 caps extra fully-missed present regions. Inequality: L_miss <= M_miss + 0.02.
noninferiority_rationale.runtime_regression_frac: L may not cost >25% more wall time than M without benefit. Inequality: L_rt <= M_rt * 1.25.
noninferiority_rationale.cost_regression_frac: L may not cost >25% more $ than M without benefit. Inequality: L_cost <= M_cost * 1.25.
